AbbVie go-to-market change 2026 direct to patient pharmacy Humira Skyrizi Rinvoq

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：AbbVie 美國藥品主要經獨立批發商（McKesson、Cardinal、Cencora 幾乎涵蓋全部美國藥品銷售），部分直售零售商、藥局、病人；通路結構為傳統批發模式。
findings.excerpt: In the United States, AbbVie distributes pharmaceutical products principally through independent wholesale distributors, with some sales directly to retailers, pharmacies, patients or other customers.

findings.claim: 2026 年 1 月 AbbVie 與美國政府簽三年自願協議，內容含 Medicaid 低價、擴大部分產品的直接面向病人現金支付選項、十年 1000 億美元美國投資。
findings.source: AbbVie 財報電話會議逐字稿（financialfilings.com 轉載）
findings.excerpt: the company announced a voluntary agreement with the U.S. government that reinforces its commitment to patient access and affordability. Key elements include offering low prices in Medicaid, expanding direct-to-patient cash pay options for select products, and committing $100 billion in U.S. R&D and capital investments over the next decade.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 直接面向病人量體與營收占比未查到；Humira 約 $950 直銷價僅見二手德文報導，未核一手。
